summary: Short kerb at a junction with turn lanes; no room to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the west side, homes 25 m or more away, but the stretch is a junction approach.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb lies in a marked turn-lane approach with a median island; no pull-off clear of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial junction with multiple lanes and turn arrows.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this stretch; signed 2 min passenger loading zone on school days.

sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the west edge; open to the east sun.
